nodes.label: aidlc-worktree info Subcommand
nodes.rationale: A pinned JSON-plus-exit-code contract between the deterministic tool and the LLM's prose composition: the tool resolves slug, path, branch_name, audit_timestamp and merge_held from the audit log so the orchestrator interpolates facts rather than guessing them. Exit 1 mirrors verify's semantics (non-zero is the halt signal), and on a malformed block the tool refuses to guess, leaving flagging and remediation to doctor.

nodes.label: WORKTREE_CREATED Audit Event
nodes.rationale: Emitted by aidlc-worktree.ts handleCreate and the sole source of worktree path and branch name; the audit log, not the filesystem, is the source of truth read back by info.

nodes.label: merge_held Field
nodes.rationale: Reflects the Merge-Held field of the per-Bolt forked state, defaulting to false when the file is absent, so the orchestrator can decide on resume whether dispatching a merge is safe while sibling halt-and-ask questions are still open.

nodes.label: Most-Recent Worktree Semantics
nodes.rationale: info walks the audit log end-to-start and returns the latest matching create, matching the user's mental model of 'the live worktree for slug X'; a retry does not create a new event, so output stays stable across retry attempts.

nodes.label: AUQ Long-Path Truncation Fallback
nodes.rationale: Documented but deliberately not implemented: current behaviour assumes graceful terminal wrap, and the leading-ellipsis-at-directory-boundaries rule (preserving the bolt-<slug> tail, via a future --max-path-display flag) is written down only so a Windows/mosh/narrow-tmux regression has a pre-decided answer.
